Ticket:
Where did our lab results go?

Hi there, I am reaching out because I am really confused about our lab feeds. Yesterday everything was coming in fine, but today when I opened up the diagnostic review section, it was completely empty. I know for a fact our reference lab sent over at least a dozen reports this morning because the courier dropped off hard copies, but nothing is showing up in our software inbox. I tried restarting my workstation and checking the connection status page under admin settings, and it says everything is running normally. Could someone please check on our backend data stream to see why these reports are getting stuck?
